```{=html}
<header class="c-pagehead">
  <div class="c-wrap">
<h1>Join us</h1>
    <p>
      Three ways to work with the centre. All of them are voluntary, in both
      directions — we charge nothing, and we pay nothing.
    </p>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--paper" id="students">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-split">
      <div class="c-prose">
        <h2>Junior student research fellowship</h2>
        <p>
          The main route into the centre, and the reason it exists. It is aimed at
          undergraduates in their first three years — earlier than most programmes
          will take you, which is the point.
        </p>

        <h3>Who should apply</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Life sciences, biotechnology, genetic engineering and biochemistry</li>
          <li>Computer science, software engineering and data science</li>
          <li>Medicine, public health, pharmacy and allied health sciences</li>
          <li>Geography, environmental science and statistics</li>
        </ul>

        <h3>What you will do</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><strong>Work with a supervisor one-to-one</strong> in one of the four research divisions.</li>
          <li><strong>Run a real project</strong> — form the hypothesis, do the analysis, interpret the result.</li>
          <li><strong>Learn to write it up</strong>: literature review, figures, manuscript drafting, and the peer review process end to end.</li>
          <li><strong>Take the training</strong> in Linux, R, Python, Nextflow, machine learning and GIS as the project requires it.</li>
        </ul>

        <h3>What we expect</h3>
        <p>
          Consistency more than brilliance. Projects run over months and the most
          common reason one fails is that a student disappears in week six, not
          that the analysis was too hard.
        </p>

        <h3>How to apply</h3>
        <p>
          Email us with a short statement of what you want to work on and why, your
          year and discipline, and a CV if you have one. There is no form and no
          deadline pressure — we read them as they arrive.
        </p>

        <p>
          <a class="c-btn c-btn--dark" href="mailto:chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Application%20for%20Junior%20Student%20Research%20Fellowship">Apply as a junior fellow</a>
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="c-aside">
        <dl class="c-facts">
          <dt>Eligibility</dt>
          <dd>University students in years 1–3, any relevant discipline.</dd>

          <dt>Prior experience</dt>
          <dd>None required. Training is provided.</dd>

          <dt>Cost</dt>
          <dd>None. We do not charge fees.</dd>

          <dt>Stipend</dt>
          <dd>None. The centre is entirely voluntary.</dd>

          <dt>Location</dt>
          <dd>Hybrid and online — GitHub, Slack or Discord, and Google Meet — so students outside Dhaka can take part.</dd>

          <dt>Commitment</dt>
          <dd>Months, not weeks. Projects run to publication.</dd>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--white" id="mentors">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-split">
      <div class="c-prose">
        <h2>Volunteer mentors and research leads</h2>
        <p>
          If you are a graduate student, postdoctoral fellow, academic or industry
          data scientist, a few hours a week from you supports a team of students
          who would otherwise have no supervision at all.
        </p>

        <h3>What mentoring involves</h3>
        <ul>
          <li>Guiding a team of two to four undergraduates on one focused project.</li>
          <li>A periodic check-in and code review — usually fortnightly.</li>
          <li>Supervising manuscript preparation, and co-authoring where you have contributed.</li>
        </ul>

        <p>
          You do not need to be in Bangladesh, and you do not need to commit
          beyond one project cycle.
        </p>

        <p>
          <a class="c-btn c-btn--dark" href="mailto:chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Volunteer%20as%20a%20Mentor">Volunteer as a mentor</a>
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="c-aside">
        <dl class="c-facts">
          <dt>Time</dt>
          <dd>A few hours a week, one project cycle.</dd>

          <dt>Location</dt>
          <dd>Anywhere. Supervision is remote.</dd>

          <dt>Authorship</dt>
          <dd>Co-authorship where you have contributed to the work.</dd>

          <dt>Useful backgrounds</dt>
          <dd>Bioinformatics · epidemiology · machine learning · biostatistics · GIS · scientific writing</dd>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--paper" id="institutions">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Institutions</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">Academic and institutional collaboration</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        We work with laboratories, research centres, hospitals and non-profits,
        contributing multi-omics analysis, predictive modelling, geospatial work
        and methodology for joint studies and grant proposals.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="c-btn-row">
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--dark" href="/collaborators/">How collaboration works</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--line" href="mailto:chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Research%20Collaboration%20Inquiry">Propose a collaboration</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--panel">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Questions</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">Before you write to us</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="c-grid-2">
      <div>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Do I need to be able to code?</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 1.75rem">No. The foundation courses assume nothing. What matters is curiosity and turning up consistently.</p>

        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Is it remote or in person?</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.7;margin:0">Mostly remote, via GitHub, chat and video calls, so students at universities across Bangladesh can take part.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Is there a fee or a stipend?</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 1.75rem">Neither. Participation costs nothing and pays nothing. We measure ourselves in publications and in where our alumni end up.</p>

        <h3 style="font-family:var(--c-display);font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 .5rem">Will I actually be an author?</h3>
        <p style="font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.7;margin:0">If you do the work, yes — including first authorship. See <a href="/publications/" style="color:var(--c-green)">our publications</a>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
